question: For each consultant, how many active candidates have not been contacted for more than two weeks?
sql: WITH active_c AS (SELECT DISTINCT candidate_id FROM applications WHERE status = 'active'), last_contact AS (SELECT a.candidate_id, MAX(substr(a.at,1,10)) AS last_at FROM activities a GROUP BY a.candidate_id) SELECT co.name AS consultant, co.desk AS desk, COUNT(c.id) AS stale_active_candidates FROM consultants co LEFT JOIN candidates c ON c.consultant_id = co.id AND c.id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM active_c) AND (SELECT lc.last_at FROM last_contact lc WHERE lc.candidate_id = c.id) IS NOT NULL AND julianday('2026-11-25') - julianday((SELECT lc.last_at FROM last_contact lc WHERE lc.candidate_id = c.id)) > 14 OR (c.consultant_id = co.id AND c.id IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM active_c) AND c.id NOT IN (SELECT candidate_id FROM last_contact)) GROUP BY co.id, co.name, co.desk ORDER BY stale_active_candidates DESC, co.name LIMIT 200
answer: Three consultants have active candidates not contacted for over two weeks: Hannah Pryce (Quant Research) has 3, Tom Okafor (Low-Latency Engineering) has 3, and Priya Raman (AI/ML) has 2.

meta.note: Active = has an application with status 'active'; stale = last activity more than 14 days before 2026-11-25 or no activity at all; counted per owning consultant.
